headings.usage: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for all headings. Never use Inter or Roboto.

body.usage: Use relaxed line height (leading-relaxed) for readable course descriptions and blog posts.

seasonal_theme_system.concept: Professional color-shifting and subtle banner injections. Do not use cartoon vectors.
seasonal_theme_system.implementation: Use CSS variables for --brand-accent. e.g., default uses Blue, Diwali shifts accent to Gold/Orange (#F59E0B), Christmas to Crimson (#E11D48). Inject a minimal top announcement banner. No falling snow or disruptive animations.

surfaces.marketing_header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-slate-950/60 (dark), 1px bottom border-border/40. NEVER use complete transparent background.
surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat Solid: bg-card, border border-border, shadow-sm. NO glassmorphism in admin.
surfaces.marketing_cards: Use subtle hover lift (-translate-y-1) with shadow-lg for Course and Trainer cards.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grid background (bg-grid-slate-200/50) in Hero section to establish the IT/Tech vibe without overwhelming the content.

marketing.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section paddings.
marketing.pattern: Bento Grid (Mode A) for 'Why Choose Us' and 'Course Features'. Asymmetrical, col-span-full to col-span-4 variations. gap-8.

dashboard.pattern: High-Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6. Sidebar navigation (w-64) with main content area.

components_strategy.marketing_ui: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for expressive layouts. Overlapping images, absolute positioning for decorative elements.
components_strategy.dashboard_ui: Use Shadcn UI strictly. Tables, Cards, Dialogs, Select, Forms.
components_strategy.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts) for dashboard analytics (Enquiries, Revenue, Placements).
components_strategy.forms: React Hook Form + Zod + Shadcn Form components for Enquiry/Registration.

motion.marketing: Staggered fade-up entrances for Course grids. Subtle parallax on Hero image using Framer Motion. Micro-interactions on CTA buttons.
motion.dashboard: Minimal. Only instant feedback (hover states, toast popups). No layout entrance animations to maintain fast feel.

media.icons: lucide-react for standard UI. @phosphor-icons/react for marketing feature blocks.
media.logo_strategy: Use a combination of a Lucide Icon (e.g., 'Cloud' or 'Waves') + Typography ('CloudWave') in the Header. Do NOT use external placeholder image services.

instructions_to_main_agent: UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic (generic centered layouts, uniform styling).
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties like opacity, transform.
Never center align the main App container. Use standard block flow.
Use pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) modern buttons.
Never use emoji characters for icons. Use the specified icon libraries.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Use 2-3x more spacing (Tailwind p-8 to p-24) in Marketing sections.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='enquiry-submit-btn').
For the dynamic seasonal theme, create a Context or simple state that provides the current theme, and apply CSS variables to the root. DO NOT overcomplicate with heavy graphics.
Admin Dashboard must follow the Data-Ink Ratio: remove unnecessary borders, use skeleton loaders for data fetching.
Use sonner for all toast notifications.
